gen-gf-offside-gf-matemasie: Matemasie reads as a plain sans with broad gaps between glyphs and small entry points into its round letters. Matemasie is the closed, tidy half here, while Offside's curves refuse to shut, and that gap is the whole charm.
gen-gf-offside-gf-menbere: Menbere stacks its lowercase tall, like rolled cord, and the sans reads clean and unfussy. And Offside, with its widely tracked, commanding display letters, gives the page a loud opening before that tidy column takes over.
gen-gf-offside-gf-mitr:
Mitr reads as a plain sans with barely any gap between x-height and cap height.

Offside's strokes carry no contrast at all, so its wide-tracked, open-curved headings and Mitr's compact, friendly text feel like one family at two volumes.
gen-gf-offside-gf-momo-trust-display: Offside's curves refuse to close, giving its headings a commanding, widely tracked look. And Momo Trust Display, a sans-serif with a generous x-height and drifting letters, carries a longer passage in a clean, unhurried way.
gen-gf-offside-gf-mukta: Offside's strokes bend like a paperclip and its tracked-out letters hold a commanding, level beat across every heading. Mukta, a plain sans with tall-bodied small letters, does the quiet reading.
gen-gf-offside-gf-mukta-mahee: Mukta Mahee brings chunky, tall lowercase letters that feel approachable and clean, a plain sans with some heft. And Offside, stout as a drawn pipe cleaner, handles the loud display moments while Mukta Mahee does the steady talking.
gen-gf-offside-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar is a sans-serif with compressed ascenders, so its text sits low and tidy under Offside's stencil-cut, commanding headings. A longer passage feels approachable and neutral.
gen-gf-offside-gf-mukta-vaani: Mukta Vaani reads as a contemporary, neutral sans-serif with a high-waisted lowercase. Mukta Vaani stays modest while Offside, poured at one width with curves that refuse to close, earns its keep in big, short lines.
gen-gf-offside-gf-narnoor: Narnoor sets short ascenders above big bowls, a professional plain sans with a quiet, level texture. Over a longer passage it hums along, never crowding Offside.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-display:
Noto Sans Display fills every word with a big, tall middle zone.

A longer passage in it feels approachable and plain, a steady counterweight to Offside's technical-pen precision and its wide-tracked, commanding headings.
